task.description: Validate TEST-DESIGNER's step-12 result (PASS, commit 98d8ad2a): targeted tests 23/23 passing, full suite 4511/4513 (2 pre-existing unrelated failures), both mutants reverted cleanly (lib/ byte-identical to REVIEWER-gated state). TEST-DESIGNER flagged an honest, non-blocking judgment call for you: neither of the two mutants (removing the per-tenant isolation rescue in replay_all_pending/0; making MigrationReplayBoot.start_link/1 propagate instead of always :ignore) was actually caught by any test, because Letflow.TenantProvisioning.replay_migrations/1's own internal rescue (lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex:395-397) already converts every exception into {:error, {:migration_failed, exception}} before either outer-layer rescue can ever trigger. If the latter, decide whether that's acceptable (defense-in-depth for a code path no test can reach is still defensible) or whether it should be flagged as a follow-up (e.g., a test that bypasses replay_migrations/1's own rescue somehow, to actually exercise the outer layer) -- your call, state your reasoning either way in the result.
